Aim & Scope

The International Journal of Advanced Research in Technology (IJART) is a peer-reviewed, open-access journal dedicated to disseminating high-quality original research, reviews, and short communications across all domains of engineering and applied sciences. The journal welcomes contributions from academia, research institutions, and industry worldwide.

IJART is committed to fast, transparent, and rigorous peer review, ensuring that published articles meet the highest standards of scientific integrity and contribute meaningfully to the global body of knowledge.

Open Access Policy

IJART is a fully open-access journal. All articles are freely available online immediately upon publication under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0) license. Authors retain copyright of their work. The journal is funded through Article Processing Charges (APC).

Publication Ethics

IJART adheres to the ethical guidelines established by the Committee on Publication Ethics (COPE) and is committed to maintaining the highest standards of integrity in scholarly publishing. The journal enforces strict policies against plagiarism, data fabrication, falsification, and improper authorship practices.

All submitted manuscripts undergo rigorous similarity screening using iThenticate to ensure originality and prevent academic misconduct. Furthermore, authors, reviewers, and editors are required to disclose any potential conflicts of interest to promote transparency and unbiased decision-making throughout the publication process.

By upholding these ethical principles, IJART ensures the credibility, reliability, and academic value of all published research.
